Connect Binance

API Key
Secret Key

How to get API keys from Binance

  1. Log into your Binance account.
  2. Go to Account → API Keys.
  3. Click Create API.
  4. Select System generated.
  5. Label your keys (e.g. "deltabadger") and pass the security verification if necessary.
  6. Click Edit restrictions in the top-right corner of the keys tile.
    1. 🔘 Restrict access to trusted IPs only: whitelist the IP address of the machine where Deltabadger is installed. If running on a server, use the server's public IP. If it's your local computer check your IP here.
      ⚠️ Important: Do this first to enable the next step.
    2. Check:
      ☑️ Enable Reading
      ☑️ Enable Spot & Margin Trading.
      ⚠️ Important: The keys will not work if you add more permissions.
  7. Click Save and pass the security verification if necessary.
  8. Copy and paste your new API keys above.
